name: quakec
description: QuakeC IntelliSense, diagnostics, and code browsing, with support for gmqcc and FTEQCC language extensions.
author: Joshua Skelton

enumDescriptions: gmqcc's default standard (-std=gmqcc): const, C-style functions, for/switch, typedef, enum, arrays, attributes, and more.
gmqcc with -std=fteqcc: the same syntax, with FTEQCC's predefined macros.
gmqcc with -std=qcc: original QuakeC. Reports C-style functions and newer operators.
quakec.language.markdownDescription: The QuakeC standard to check code against. Matches the `-std` option of gmqcc.

scripts.postinstall: cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install && cd ../parser && npm install && cd ..
